meta.title: 接納文化多樣性
meta.subtitle: 學習其他文化能讓你的生活更美好

content.contentEn: You may never have thought about it, but much of your personality and many of your interests and values come from your culture. Your culture determines the language you speak, your tastes in food and music, your manners and your priorities. But exposure to different cultures can improve your life, inspire creativity and even help you understand your own culture better.
content.contentZh: 你可能從未想過，但你的個性、興趣和價值觀很大一部分都源自於你的文化。你的文化決定了你說的語言、對食物和音樂的品味、你的禮儀以及你衡量事物的優先順序。然而，接觸不同的文化可以改善你的生活、激發創意，甚至幫助你更了解自己的文化。

content.contentEn: Had it not been for cultural diversity, a number of inventions would never have existed. In the 1970s, Hidekazu Tojo, a Japanese immigrant in Canada, wanted to cater to Canadian tastes. He developed a new sushi roll using cooked crab with seaweed on the inside rather than the outside. This creation, the California roll, became very popular around the world.
content.contentZh: 若非文化多樣性，許多發明可能根本不會存在。1970 年代，一位在加拿大的日本移民東條英勝想迎合當地人口味。他開發出新型壽司捲，使用熟蟹肉並將海苔包在裡面。這項發明「加州捲」隨後風靡全球。

content.contentEn: Cultural diversity played a similar role in music. In New Orleans, USA, various musical traditions from Africa and European countries blended into a new style in the 1920s: jazz.
content.contentZh: 文化多樣性在音樂中也扮演類似角色。美國紐奧良匯集了來自非洲與歐洲的音樂傳統，在 1920 年代融合成新的風格：爵士樂。

content.contentEn: Culture encompasses more than food and art. It includes different expectations for behavior and different values. Disagreements on points like punctuality versus greeting neighbors are often rooted in different cultural values. Challenging your own culture's ideas can help you grow and change your views.
content.contentZh: 文化包含的不僅是食物與藝術，還包括行為期待與價值觀。對於「準時」或「問候鄰居」的分歧通常源於文化差異。挑戰自己文化的觀念能幫助你成長並改變觀點。

content.contentEn: Embracing cultural diversity requires courage, humility, patience, and kindness. It leaves us with a richer understanding of the world and may even inspire us to create something new, like California rolls or jazz.
content.contentZh: 接納文化多樣性需要勇氣、謙遜、耐心與仁慈。這讓我們對世界有更豐富的理解，並激發我們創造新事物，就像加州捲或爵士樂一樣。

vocabulary.exEn: The city is known for its cultural diversity.
vocabulary.exZh: 這座城市以其文化多樣性聞名。

vocabulary.exEn: Early exposure to music can help a child's brain development.
vocabulary.exZh: 早期接觸音樂有助於孩童的大腦發育。

vocabulary.exEn: Many immigrants struggled to adapt to the new environment.
vocabulary.exZh: 許多移民掙扎著適應新環境。
